title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 458 (Delegation by Central Government of its powers and functions)

content.overview: The Central Government may delegate any of its powers or functions under the Act to a Regional Director, Registrar or any other authority, by notification.
content.glance: The Central Government may delegate any of its powers or functions under the Act to a Regional Director, Registrar or any other authority, by notification.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 458 (Delegation by Central Government of its powers and functions). The Central Government may delegate any of its powers or functions under the Act to a Regional Director, Registrar or any other authority, by notification. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Central Government may delegate any of its powers or functions under the Act to a Regional Director, Registrar or any other authority, by notification.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Delegation is by notification. The delegate acts within the notification. The power to make rules is not delegated by implication.
